sources.title: Golisopod-GX — Sun & Moon Burning Shadows 17/147（First Impression）
sources.documentVersion: Official international card database; English card text cross-checked against the Rainier card database 2026-10-07 (pokemon.com page blocked automated reading)
sources.supportsZh: “If this Pokémon was on the Bench and became your Active Pokémon this turn, this attack does 90 more damage.”：这只宝可梦在本回合内从备战区来到战斗位（撤退、交换效果，或本回合内击倒后替补）时追加伤害。新写法 “If this Pokémon moved from your Bench to the Active Spot this turn” 意思相同。回合之间（宝可梦检查后）替补上场的不算“本回合”。

sources.title: Drampa-GX — Sun & Moon Guardians Rising 115/145（Berserk）
sources.documentVersion: Official international card database; English card text cross-checked against the Rainier card database 2026-10-07 (pokemon.com page blocked automated reading)
sources.supportsZh: “If your Benched Pokémon have any damage counters on them, this attack does 70 more damage.”：己方任意一只备战宝可梦身上有伤害指示物即可（战斗宝可梦身上的不算）。

dataContractZh: 新条件 BECAME_ACTIVE_THIS_TURN（只接受 target，单只公开宝可梦）。DAMAGE_COUNTER_COUNT 新增群体目标 OWN_BENCH / OPPONENT_BENCH / ALL_OWN_POKEMON / ALL_OPPONENT_POKEMON：数值为该组全部宝可梦的伤害指示物合计（空组为 0），“有任何指示物”写成 value 1。
serverAuthorityZh: BattlefieldState 在交换、撤退、替补三种“从备战区到战斗位”时记下当时的回合数；条件只在当前回合数相同时成立。群体计数由服务器按当前公开场上逐只相加。
limitations: “如果这只宝可梦本回合被回复过”“上个对手回合被攻击伤害过”等其它回合内事件记录不在本组件内。
